title: An implementation of an upgradeable contract whose constructor ran _disableInitializers() can never be initialized or reinitialized; a proxy's initializer runs once
detail: Changed for the AMM-neutral design: the PositionProxy has no initializer at all (REQ-PROXY-001), so this check now covers only the UUPS contracts; the proxy is covered by FV-CTL-87.

title: After any implementation change only the timelock (UUPS reinitializer inside upgradeToAndCall) changes an upgradeable contract's state, and only the AaveAdapter (execute) can make a PositionProxy act: the proxy has no initializer, upgrade, role, receiver or fallback selector, and the page states its inventory as execute plus the four views
detail: Changed for the AMM-neutral design: the beacon form and its no-reinitializer rule are gone; the proxy is logic-free and immutable, so an Adapter upgrade changes account logic for every proxy at once.

title: The append-only layout rule accepts exactly the appending and identical layouts and rejects every delete, retype, insert and reorder
detail: Namespaces are disjoint by construction: each root is keccak256(keccak256(id) - 1) & ~0xff over distinct ids; collision resistance is assumed. The PositionProxy has no storage layout to keep (immutables only).

title: One PositionProxy per (wallet, CDP Spoke, market): equal CREATE2 addresses from the ProxyManager imply the same triple, no other deployer and no other Adapter can produce a triple's address, so no Hub, Spoke or market occupies another's proxy (keccak and CREATE2 modelled as injective)
detail: Changed for the AMM-neutral design: the key is (wallet, spoke, marketId), not (wallet, spoke), and the init code carries the Adapter and the triple.

title: For every deployed account the Adapter, Lens and previewPledge views equal the stored proxyOf(wallet, marketId), Lens reports deployed = true; deployProxy refuses a frozen wallet and predictProxy reads no MarketRegistry state
detail: Changed for the AMM-neutral design: the ProxyManager is immutable, so no upgrade can change the creation code; predictProxy has no registry input (REQ-PROXY-099).

title: The address the views show before an account exists (deployed = false) is the address deployProxy later creates, and deployProxy's own equality check with predictProxy cannot fail, for the chain's lifetime (immutable ProxyManager, fixed ADAPTER and creation-code hash)

checkRecordBacking returns an empty page whenever offset >= nextRecordId and otherwise walks offset .. offset + min(limit, n - offset) - 1 with no underflow or overflow, at most limit IDs, all below nextRecordId, for every 256-bit offset, limit and nextRecordId
The Lens paging rules give checkRecordBacking one outcome for every (offset, limit, nextRecordId)

Flash-premium ceiling: liquidate takes no flash loan and the Lens preview and the borrow gate read no flash source (REQ-SWAP-012, REQ-LENS-029, REQ-RISK-062); every page that takes a loan (2.9 REQ-PSTORE-024, 2.11 SPEC-LIQ-015, REQ-FLASH-001/002/003, REQ-SWAP-013, REQ-HELPER-005) states the exact form phi x 10^4 <= maxFlashFeeBps x F, launch 10 bps; SettlementMath.flashPremiumWithinCap, called by the flash source and the helper, equals it for every input, and a quote that passes before the loan implies the Pool's charge passes in the callback (SPEC-LIQ-015 example: 5 bps on 1,950 USDC passes, 20 bps fails)
detail: Changed for Q-404: liquidate takes no flash loan, so the Lens premiumWithinMax flag no longer exists; the check now covers the loans that remain (deleverage, the flash liquidation helper) and the rules that keep the loan out of liquidation. Page forms: REQ-PSTORE-024=ok, SPEC-LIQ-015=ok, REQ-FLASH-001=ok, REQ-FLASH-002=ok, REQ-FLASH-003=ok, REQ-SWAP-013=ok, REQ-HELPER-005=ok, REQ-SWAP-012=ok, REQ-LENS-029=ok, REQ-RISK-062=ok, launch 10=ok, example=ok. Code: SettlementMath branch m <= 10^4=ok, SettlementMath branch m > 10^4=ok, flash/AaveV3FlashSource.sol=ok, periphery/flash-liquidator/FlashLiquidatorBase.sol=ok, LiquidationPreview has no flash field=ok.

title: Every view a third party can call mid-operation either reverts while the Lock is held or reads state the locked call does not write before its last external call
